hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Session-start Git check: git unavailable. Follow .claude/skills/resume/SKILL.md by hand.'; exit 0; }; n=$(set -o pipefail; git status --porcelain -z 2>/dev/null | tr -cd '\000' | wc -c | tr -d ' ') || n='unknown (git status failed: run it)'; h=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); ab=$(git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD' 2>/dev/null | awk '{print "behind " $1 ", ahead " $2}'); echo "Session-start Git check: HEAD ${h:-none}, ${n:-?} uncommitted path(s), upstream ${ab:-not set}. Before other work, follow .claude/skills/resume/SKILL.md (verify CURRENT.md against Git, PRs and CI; run the checks), then report and continue."; exit 0
